unresolved: The seven normal-hearing control-group children are described only as a group (mean and range of age, audiometric criteria); they are not individually described and are not rostered.

Individual P1 latencies, IT-MAIS/MAIS and MUSS percentages, word-list percentages and correlation statistics are printed or plotted only inside figures (pixel content): recorded in visual.json, not as facts. Table 2 values are group means and are not copied to individuals.

Unlabelled counts of children are not assigned to individuals: one child at the maximum IT-MAIS/MAIS value at nine months, three children with lower MUSS scores, three children with word-list data, two children with maximum auditory performance and one with maximum oral language performance.
Source conflict: the abstract says children 6 and 7 stopped effective CI use after the first year of activation while Results say after nine months; both timings are kept review-only.

Aggregate mean values in the study-group description (sensory deprivation one year and six months; hearing aid use one year and nine months) are not the arithmetic means of the Table 1 columns; individual Table 1 values are kept literally and the aggregate means are not copied.

The Discussion uses 'maximum auditory skills (comprehension)' for three children and 'maximum auditory performance' for two children without naming a measure for the second count; the three-child count is mapped to subjects 1, 2 and 5 only as a review-only fact and the two-child count is not assigned.
Table 3 column headers read '9 months' and '5 years' without stating the reference point; the methods say after nine months of CI use.
Table 2 footnote marks significance with a hash but the table cells use an asterisk (print artefact, aggregate only).
Roster: reported count seven is the study group; the seven control children are aggregate-only and not counted as individually described patients.
Subjects 6 and 7 are first named in Results (b00026), before the Table 1 rows; patients are numbered by the Table 1 subject numbers and their identity evidence is the Table 1 row.
The Authors' Contributions paragraph (b00052) names people who are not in the article's author list; it is administrative, not clinical, and is not used.
